passenger_response.subject: Update on your disrupted journey
passenger_response.body:
Dear Kenneth Braithwaite,

Your flight AK150 on 2026-08-06 was cancelled. Our record shows the cause was a nosewheel steering fault and that the aircraft was withdrawn. There was no further FCO service on that date.

We have not been able to issue you a room from our own allocation tonight. A colleague is picking this up now. Accommodation is something you are owed here, not a favour, so do not let this drop.

We could not verify your request to change the booking or issue a benefit. Please confirm what you want us to arrange.

On their camel-coloured overcoat returned: we have passed it to the team that handles it, because it is not something this desk can settle. They will pick it up from here.

We cannot work out compensation yet. It depends on how late you actually arrive at your final destination, and that is not known until your new flight has run. It will be assessed then. Do not read this as a decision either way.

Regards,
Disruption Desk
passenger_response.note: Draft only. The operations API exposes no send operation, so this text has not reached the passenger.
